referenceScope: Pinned native/default content composition; original static Figma variants remain in stories. Source wrapper APIs and optional native render semantics are described in CEM/README.

contractCases.expected: Trace and line/title/description are passive wrappers. TraceLine status is running|error|pending; there is no automatic successful state, log transport or retry action. TraceTitle includes motion-reduce:shimmer-none. Optional TraceCollapsible/Trigger/Content delegate the actual Collapsible component. Its controlled open prop requires onOpenChange in the wrapper union; defaultOpen remains available. Trigger Enter/Space toggles, disabled suppresses changes, cancellation/control authority follows Collapsible; Escape does not close it and focus is not trapped.

This family deliberately composes the complete Collapsible reference for disclosure behavior, rather than pretending all trace lines are decorative or inventing an independent trace expansion API. Error/recovery wording is caller content; optional live announcements are task-owned.

TraceTitle/Description carry actual step/status/error text; TraceIcon is hidden by the source. Running shimmer, opacity and red color do not replace status wording. Expanded detail is readable native content.
